agent_notes: וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ: «воспылал нос его» в дословном слое сохраняет телесный образ; синодальное «воспылал гневом» приведено в комментарии.
בֵּית הַסֹּהַר: в дословном слое «дом Сохар» (слово не переведено), в драматическом и примечаниях — «темница», как в Синодальном переводе. Название «Сохар» введено здесь впервые.

שַׂר: «начальник» (как в Синодальном: «начальник темницы»), в комментарии поясняется, что это должностное лицо, а не тюремщик. חֶסֶד: в синодальном «милость»; в дословном слое «неизменная милость/верность».

history.note: [consider] Consider «неизменную милость» in the literal layer and gloss, as the note intended. (GEN.39.21: וַיֵּט אֵלָיו חָסֶד; English literal: "extended to him steadfast kindness")

agent_notes: «Хлеб» оставлен «хлебом» (лехем), как просит английский слой; в Синодальном переводе тоже «хлеб».
Синодальное «спи со мною» мягче и устарелее, чем שכבה עמי; в буквальном слое «ляг со мной», в драматическом «Ложись со мной».
Начало буквального слоя переписано по замечанию: «Не больше он в доме этом, чем я», чтобы сравнение читалось сразу; синодальное «нет больше меня» сохраняет сравнение, но в другом порядке слов.

history.note: [should_fix] Rewrite the opening of translation_literal so that the comparison is clear from the start, e.g. «Не больше он в доме этом, чем я» or «Нет его больше меня в доме этом», and keep the rest of the verse. (GEN.39.9: אֵינֶנּוּ גָדוֹל בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה מִמֶּנִּי; English literal: "He is not greater in this house than I"; Synodal: «нет больше меня в доме сем»)

notes.note: All 23 verses are covered. The chapter has no time word beyond 'after these things' (v7), 'day by day' (v10) and 'about this day' (v11), so everything else is placed by plausible intervals and tier MACRO_ERA. There is no divine or prophetic speech in the chapter, so no FULFILLS_PROPHECY. Gen 40 should anchor on the end of the prison stay.
[entity:group.ishmaelites] TIPNR tags the Ishmaelites of 39:1 with person.ishmael (the patriarch); I used the existing group.ishmaelites instead, as in Gen 37, and did not link the patriarch.
[component:comp.joseph.master.1] Closed at 39:20 when Joseph is put in prison. Joseph's status SLAVE (comp.joseph.status.1) is left open because the text does not release him.
[entity:group.ishmaelites] TIPNR tags the Ishmaelites of 39:1 with person.ishmael (the patriarch); I used the existing group.ishmaelites instead, as in Gen 37, and did not link the patriarch.
[entity:group.hebrews] TIPNR Hebrews@Gen.14.13-Heb is a people, so a group entity. First defined here for this book; Genesis 14 is outside the corpus. Her use of 'Hebrew' is a slur for a foreigner.
[entity:person.potiphars_wife] Unnamed in the text; identified by role. The Hebrew 'wife of his master' is the only designation (39:7). Later tradition names her Zuleikha, which I did not use.

[entity:person.keeper_of_prison] The prison's chief officer. Whether he is the same person as the captain of the guard (Potiphar) is not stated in Gen 39; I kept them separate, since 40:3 puts the prison in the captain of the guard's house, which is a later chapter's problem.

[component:comp.joseph.residence.1] Inferred from 39:2 and 39:20 rather than a single stated verse. Slot named residence to keep the finer house and prison locations apart from comp.joseph.whereabouts.2 (Egypt), which stays open.
[component:comp.joseph.office.2] Office slot reused after a gap in time: office.1 ends at 39:20 and office.2 opens at 39:22, so no supersedes link. Value PRISON_ADMINISTRATOR is my label for 39:22.
[component:comp.garment_of_joseph_at_potiphar.holder.1] Left open: the text does not say what happens to the garment after Potiphar hears her.
[system:sys.false_accusation] Defined here, new in the catalog. Category LEGAL_CUSTOM is a stretch, since the accusation is private rather than a court process.
[system:sys.divine_blessing_prosperity] Defined here; no existing system covers 'the LORD is with him and makes him prosper'. Category SUPERNATURAL_ACT.
[system:sys.imprisonment] Defined here. No coordinates for loc.royal_prison and loc.potiphars_house, which are unlocated in the registry; place in Egypt is not narrowed further.
[event_links:evt.gen_39.joseph_bought] Place left at loc.egypt: the text names no city and no place of sale.
[event_links:evt.gen_39.joseph_jailed] Royal prisoners listed as PRESENT because 39:20 describes the place, not an act by them.
